blocks.text: For Kirk Bondad, Mister International is the leading male pageant in the world. The 2025 winner from the Philippines made this declaration when he delivered his farewell speech at the 2026 competition in Thailand on Saturday, Sept. 26. “After everything I’ve seen, I stand here tonight and say this with absolute pride, Mister International stands at the very top of male pageantry,” the German-Filipino model and content creator said at the 18th Mister International final competition at MCC Hall at The Mall Lifestore Bangkapi in Bangkok. Bondad first represented the Philippines at the 11th Mister World pageant held in Vietnam in […]...
